title: GhostGraph-T action-identifiable temporal recovery benchmark v1
research_question: Can a globally optimized active policy identify the minimum erasure-action equivalence class, or fail closed on a family outside its catalogue, with fewer probes than exhaustive testing?

statistics.aggregation: report every strategy and split separately; no blended novelty score
statistics.zero_event_interpretation: report the Wilson upper bound; zero observed errors is not proof of zero population risk

invalid_run_rules: post-reveal algorithm, threshold, split, seed, or gate change
omitting a negative or failed result
claim_boundary: Project-authored finite temporal graph grammar and deterministic 300-case locked benchmark. Instance holdout tests new structures inside known families; composition holdout tests new combinations; family holdout tests only OUT_OF_HYPOTHESIS detection, not localization of the unknown family. Passing does not prove arbitrary open-world coverage, independent evidence, production FaceID/eGov behavior, legal compliance, patentability, or global novelty.
